text.p: Jennifer Convertibles Inc said on Tuesday it has filed its financial results with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the 1995 and 1994 fiscal years and its quarterly reports through the quarter ended May 25, 1996.

In a statement on September 6, 1996, Jennifer said it reported a loss of $12.1 million on sales of $126.1 million for the year ended August 1995. In fiscal 1994, the company reported a $14.6 million loss on sales of $97.4 million.
However, the company's auditors, Richard A. Eisner & Co LLP, said it had been unable to obtain sufficient documentation to render an unqualified opinion.
Jennifer Convertibles said it had been delayed in filing its financial statements with the Securities and Exchange Commission due to a change in its accounting practices and other matters.
The furniture retailer expects to file its 10K report for fiscal 1996 and all future financial statements with the SEC on a timely basis, the company said.
